request.style: English, intimate piano ballad, tender female vocal, piano, cello, soft strings, quiet and emotional, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She came into the Pharisee's house uninvited
With an alabaster jar and a name everyone knew
She knelt at his feet and the tears came falling
She wiped them with her hair, she didn't know what else to do

[Verse]
Simon watched from the table and he thought within his heart
If this man were a prophet he would know who she is
But Jesus turned toward the woman and said to Simon
Do you see this woman

[Chorus]
Her many sins have been forgiven
For she loved much
But the one who is forgiven little
Loves little

[Verse]
You gave me no water for my feet
But she has wet my feet with her tears
You gave me no kiss
But she has not stopped kissing my feet

[Chorus]
Her many sins have been forgiven
For she loved much
But the one who is forgiven little
Loves little

[Outro]
Your sins are forgiven
Your faith has saved you
Go in peace
